services.name: Series X Jet Car Rental
services.desc: Get ready for an exhilarating adventure on our New Jet Car. Once we cut you loose, enjoy the intercostal, where you ride within a perimeter. Never been in a Jet Car before? No problem! Our friendly guides will be right there with you, ensuring your safety while you unleash your inner speed demon! So, what are you waiting for? Hit that “Book Now” button and let the adventure begin! Your epic day on the water is just a click

services.name: Jet Ski Rental (Freestyle Rides)

blurb: Guests rent jet skis or jet cars to explore local waters including Safety Harbor, Palm Harbor, Oldsmar, and Clearwater Beach. Rentals include safety gear and a briefing. Options include freestyle rides, dolphin tours, and private events like birthdays and corporate outings.
extraNote: A $250 security deposit PER JET SKI OR JET CAR is required when on property; via debit or credit card upon arrival, along with a matching ID. · You are responsible for any repair costs exceeding the deposit. · Same-day bookings are non-refundable. · With Peek Protect: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a refund. · You may reschedule once, but rescheduled bookings are non-refundable and cannot be changed again. · Weather-related issues: We will try to reschedule your activity. · If rescheduling is not possible, a refund may be issued at the guide’s discretion. · Deposit $250 per ski, refunded at end of ride · Picture and video package available for additional $40
